_comment: Canonical brand references. TWO CONSUMERS, ONE FILE. (1) The guide illustration generator (netlify/functions/generate-illustration-background.js) reads the flat `characters` / `brand` / `approvedScenes` keys — those are unchanged and must stay exactly as they are. (2) The social artwork system (scripts/lib/social/refs.js) reads `library`, which describes every reference as an object with an id, a group, a role and the slide families it serves. The social system NEVER hardcodes a filename; if a reference is not in `library` it does not exist, and a missing required reference fails loudly rather than being silently substituted with a generic design.

groups.label: Poster references
groups.note: The approved social poster direction. One per slide family. Every social image request attaches the poster for the family it is drawing.

groups.label: Mama character references
groups.note: Identity. Face, hair, outfit palette, proportions.

groups.label: Papa character references
groups.note: Identity. Face, beard, outfit palette, proportions.

groups.label: Ari character references
groups.note: Identity. Age, hair, outfit palette, proportions.

groups.label: Approved family scenes
groups.note: Finished, approved artwork. One semantically relevant scene is attached to every request, for finish and composition language.

groups.label: Brand reference board
groups.note: Palette, paper tone and the logo lockup. Attached to every request.

groups.label: Paper, brush and decorative
groups.note: Local composition assets the deterministic renderer draws with: paper texture, brush stroke, logo badge.

library.name: Cover / hook poster
library.note: Torn cream sheet over deep blue, two-colour painted headline, small category pill, family cut large at the foot, logo badge top-right.

library.name: Quick check poster
library.note: Three-colour stacked headline, one character centre, object clues in torn paper discs with orange label chips, blue band at the foot.

library.name: What helped us poster
library.note: Cream ground, orange and blue headline, character action dominant, numbered steps down one side with hand-drawn arrows.

library.name: Warning poster
library.note: Painted red banner headline, calm family scene, signs in red discs along the foot, deep blue reassurance band. Serious, never frightening.

library.name: Don't poster
library.note: Torn cream sheet on blue, red DON'T plus a charcoal line, crossed-out vignettes, one positive blue reset panel.

library.name: Save / CTA poster
library.note: Warm cream, blue / charcoal / orange headline, the whole family together, hand-drawn arrow to the link line, small logo at the foot.

library.name: Story / Reel poster
library.note: 9:16. Torn cream sheet over blue in the upper half, two-colour headline, characters large in the lower half, pill CTA above the bottom safe zone.

library.name: Mama — character sheet
library.note: Canonical Mama. Brown hair in a loose top bun, blue ribbed roll-neck, patched indigo jeans, cream socks.

library.name: Papa — character sheet
library.note: Canonical Papa. Black hair, full dark beard, NEVER glasses, grey hoodie with paint marks, blue jeans, white socks.

library.name: Ari — character sheet
library.note: Canonical Ari. Baby, dark tufty hair, pink floral romper with a bow, bare feet.

library.name: Ari — younger reference
library.note: Held inactive. Only for guides whose age band is genuinely younger; never chosen automatically.

library.name: Bottle refusal — approved
library.note: Mama offering a bottle, Ari waving it away, Papa thinking. The finish and crop language for feeding guides.

library.name: Writing the guide — approved
library.note: The family writing together. Warm, practical, three-figure composition.

library.name: Books and Ari — approved
library.note: Ari on a stack of books between both parents. Calm, curious, developmental.

library.name: Not doctors — approved
library.note: The crossed-out white-coat scene. The approved way to signal medical territory without pretending to be clinicians.

library.name: Brand reference board
library.note: Palette, paper tone and the logo lockup. Attached to every social image request.

library.name: Paper texture
library.note: The cream paper grain laid over every rendered slide.

library.name: Brush swoosh
library.note: The hand-drawn underline used beneath headline words.

library.name: MPC logo badge
library.note: Allowed on the cover and the closing slide only. Never on an internal slide, never on a Story information frame.
